No number is awarded for unobserved audience outcomes.

A paused or inspected pose is not animated by resize, and hidden/offscreen pauses remain intact. These are visual/source observations, not proof that a newcomer understands the intention.

deductions.kind: validation limit, not a demonstrated defect
deductions.finding: Deterministic pose continuity, cached layout and a 30fps export do not prove comfortable continuous playback or frame budget on phone/GPU targets. The new render path has not been perceptually certified in this review.
deductions.improvement: Observe normal-speed live resize/replay transitions on intended desktop and physical-phone targets; profile measured problems before proposing optimization.

improvementCriteria: Retain finite opt-in playback, per-performance semantics, native controls, ordinary reading keys, static reduced-motion alternatives and frozen paused inspection through future integration.
Close native menu and spoken-AT evidence gaps with captured results; do not substitute DOM values or programmatic selection for native speech/input.
Observe the phone discovery/revisit task and 200% zoom/reflow before claiming the prior interaction tradeoffs resolved.

For new staging changes, verify explicit transitions among play, pause, seek, hidden, resize, theme and replay; include physical-device and continuous observation if making comfort/performance claims.
implementedAssessment: Acceptable for continued local foundation work. No concrete interaction regression or new blocker found. The changes improve the visual subject relationship and preserve user control of frozen/playing content. Retain the prior 8.8 score because the same meaningful validation gaps and discovery tradeoffs remain.
limits: No full accessibility-conformance, physical-phone, native OS menu or spoken-screen-reader pass is claimed.
No continuous film perception or live performance certification. The decoded-phone-night image is one simplified comparison frame; actual DOM screenshots are the source for layout judgment.
Frame sets show offered-hand separation and staged gaze, not a measured increase in human invitation recognition, attachment or recall.
Current studio/CSS behavior is supported by unchanged hashes and prior inspection; fresh keyboard record covers the signature transport/range only.
All scores retain the same local-foundation interaction meaning. A target of nine has not caused missing evidence to be discarded.

skillsApplied.all17CatalogIntake: Reused the complete 17-entry catalogue intake recorded in the prior independent review; no false claim of rereading every full skill.
skillsApplied.practicalApplication: Design-engineering: distinguish operational feedback from requested character content and preserve immediate keyboard control. Mobile-native: separate capability/source checks and viewport geometry from actual hardware outcomes. Animation-performance: trace layout reads and scheduling boundaries, identify actual cost before proposing fixes, and refuse a fast-desktop or deterministic-export performance conclusion.
skillsApplied.designTaste: No new full design-taste reading claimed by Interaction A; this round did not redesign page hierarchy or require that specialist construction workflow.

workflowChanges: Extend the existing input/state matrix with geometry-changing events: paused resize, live resize, font completion, theme change, direct seek and replay from a corrected pose.
Track raw engine pose and displayed pose separately when an adapter modifies content; verify activation continuity against the displayed pose, not just engine state.
Treat cached layout reads and no independent staging timer as source/test findings; require a runtime trace before claiming a frame-budget improvement.
Carry forward prior unresolved native/AT/device/discovery limits in the same scoring scope rather than resetting the review to only the improved visual feature.
Keep actual DOM context images separate from simplified export scenes; both can help, but only the DOM captures establish the current page layout.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Apply UI sub-300ms budgets or never animate keyboard actions to all content
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: The 380ms staging handoff belongs to deliberately requested character content. It preserves replay/resize continuity; keyboard Play still legitimately starts the performance. Operational feedback remains immediate.

Expressive SVG articulation and five attention channels are intentional content. Preserve tiny anatomy and correctness; no blanket GPU rewrite or will-change addition is justified without measured cost.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Real-phone evidence inferred from responsive screenshots or deterministic tests
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: These verify geometry and bounded state behavior, not touch feel, spoken behavior, browser chrome or hardware cadence.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Automatic focus movement, autoplay or cramped layout to repair unobserved discovery friction
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: No new human discovery failure was observed. Preserve still-first controls and readable portrait scale; test the task before changing it.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Rebuild or edit source as part of a diagnostic skill
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: This is a frozen independent review. Concrete problems would be sent to root; none warrants a source mutation by this reviewer.

findingsTableMarkdown:
| Before | After | Why |
| Phone investigation kept a largely sideways authored glance. | Actual question bounds drive bounded gaze/head correction during the investigation. | Align visible attention with the stacked question without changing anatomy. |
| Raw engine state alone could miss the displayed correction on replay. | Replay carries the current correction into the authored handoff. | Play should begin from what the visitor sees. |
| A layout change could otherwise move an inspected pose. | Resize records a new target while paused content stays frozen until deliberate action. | Preserve the meaning of Pause and manual inspection. |
| Native-menu, spoken-AT and phone discovery outcomes were unverified. | They remain explicitly unverified; fresh keyboard transport/range evidence is narrower. | Better visuals and passing state checks cannot replace missing user-path evidence. |
